scenes.text: Your agents draft. Tanod decides what leaves.
Mei runs a design studio alone. Five AI agents do her admin. She has no technical background and no compliance team. Nobody checks what the agents actually do.
Tanod sits between her agents and the outside world. Agents can't send, pay or delete. Only Tanod can. Every action gets one of three answers: allow, hold for Mei, or block.
Any owner can set it up in minutes. Upload your files, Tanod labels what's sensitive. Write rules the way you talk.
The finance agent wrote to a client with three numbers that aren't in any file. Tanod blocks it, rewinds the agent to its last safe step, and offers a corrected reply. One tap.
An offer below Mei's floor. Some rules can't be approved away in a hurry. This is one.
One client's private fundraising plans, about to go to another client. Stopped.
An email hid instructions to forward all invoices. The agent fell for it. Tanod didn't, because the instruction came from outside.
Made a mistake? Rewind to before it. And every action is in a history that can't be quietly edited.
Every evening, Mei gets this. What her AI did today, in words she understands.
Nine scenarios caught. Zero false blocks. Tanod. Your agents draft. Tanod decides what leaves.
